message.content:
Rib knit turtleneck sweater, relaxed fit, hip length, deep crimson (#8A0303), soft cotton wool.
Wool-blend wide-leg trousers, tailored straight cut, ankle length, forest green (#2F4F4F), structured felt fabric.
Leather Chelsea boots, sleek low-cut silhouette, mid-calf height, chestnut brown (#9D5B47), smooth grained leather.
18k gold hoop earrings, medium circle shape, open back design, polished metal, solid gold.

This outfit strikes the perfect balance between cozy autumn warmth and polished elegance for a first date. The deep crimson sweater adds a romantic pop of color that aligns with her wish for red jewelry accents, while the forest green trousers offer a sophisticated, textured contrast suitable for a park setting. Leather Chelsea boots provide practical comfort for walking on uneven paths without sacrificing style, and the gold hoops serve as a refined focal point that elevates the entire look from casual to neat.
